summary: Non-profit volunteer project in rural Northeast Thailand where participants teach English in village schools and live on a campus.

facts.label: Campus accommodation
facts.value: Comfortable bungalows and a family room with veranda
facts.quote: It includes comfortable bungalows, a family room with veranda upstairs

facts.label: Volunteer activities
facts.value: English teaching at local schools with an interpreter
facts.quote: English and language teaching at local schools (with Interpreter)

facts.label: Teacher training
facts.value: Volunteers can receive free teacher training
facts.quote: volunteers can receive a Free Teacher Training

facts.label: Operating since
facts.value: Supporting local villages and schools for more than 10 years

facts.label: Thai language
facts.value: Language and cultural exchange including Thai language learning
facts.quote: Language and cultural exchange, including Thai language learning
